about: The freeze of the sweep with strangers cleared every round: each file's SHA-256 as it stood before any job of it was stepped, held by test_cleared_frozen.py. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.
on_whose_word: the maintainer's, to the cloud session: "come up with the next few and run them"
against: the grown sweep as it came back from Kaggle with every signer enrolled: the branch shared-runs/door-kaggle-runs-k3, demo/shared-runs/door/grown/runs-k3

rules.C1: passes when every folder is whole by its seal and its signature holds; the rounds of places 1 and 3 are signed by keys the ring does not hold, and every other folder by keys it does
rules.C2: passes when every round took in every earlier round of its place and held none: at places 1 and 3 on the checker's word, at the others as enrolled
rules.C3: passes when every round is the enrolled sweep's, byte for byte: the same jobs, from, stepped, ended, outcome and SHA-256, and the same states kept
rules.C4: passes when the clearings looked at every state and halt that places 1 and 3 kept in rounds one to nine, each once and no more, found every one the same, and stepped the 714369 counted beforehand
rules.C5: passes when the checks at the end stepped every kept state of all fifty rounds again and found every one the same, and every halt the memory names halts

measured: what the clearings stepped, as a share of the sweep alone
the saving once they are paid for
clearings carried on on another kind of processor
not_tested_is_not_passed: a folder that did not come back sealed leaves every rule not tested
not_frozen: the identities, which are made when the notebooks are and kept outside the repository; the Kaggle account

freeze_2.made_after: the run had come back from Kaggle and been judged, every rule passed
freeze_2.reason: bought.py's count of clearings carried on on another kind of processor looked only at the last twelve lines of each clearing's log, and after the third round the line that says so is further back than that: it said 1 of 18 where the logs say 6. It is a figure measured with no threshold; no rule reads it and no verdict changes. It is now counted from the whole of the last clearing's log, which is carried on with it and holds every time it was said.
freeze_2.verdicts: C1 to C5 as they were
